sentences.cn_text: 美国邮政服务（USPS）持续出现巨额亏损。
sentences.en_text: The U.S. Postal Service (USPS) continues to bleed red ink.

sentences.cn_text: 该机构报告称2016财年净亏损56亿美元，这是其支出超过收入的连续第10年。
sentences.en_text: It reported a net loss of $5.6 billion for fiscal 2016, the 10th straight year its expenses have exceeded revenue.

sentences.cn_text: 与此同时，该机构拥有超过1200亿美元的无资金来源负债，主要用于员工医疗保健和退休费用。
sentences.en_text: Meanwhile, it has more than $120 billion in unfunded liabilities, mostly for employee health and retirement costs.

sentences.cn_text: 这家曾经稳定的联邦机构濒临破产，原因众多。
sentences.en_text: There are many reasons this formerly stable federal institution finds itself on the verge of bankruptcy.

sentences.cn_text: 从根本上说，美国邮政服务正处于一个历史性的两难困境：一方面，技术变革永久性地降低了其核心产品——一类邮件的需求；另一方面，监管结构使管理层无法灵活调整运营以适应新现实。
sentences.en_text: Fundamentally, the USPS is in a historic squeeze between technological change that has permanently decreased demand for its bread-and-butter product, first-class mail, and a regulatory structure that denies management the flexibility to adjust its operations to the new reality.

sentences.cn_text: 从邮政工会到贺卡制造商等利益集团对美国邮政服务的最终监管者——国会——施加了基于自身利益的压力，坚持要求无论邮政服务发生何种变化，他们所依赖的现状必须得到保护。
sentences.en_text: And interest groups ranging from postal unions to greeting-card makers exert selfinterested pressure on the USPS’s ultimate overseer — Congress — insisting that whatever else happens to the Postal Service, aspects of the status quo they depend on get protected.

sentences.cn_text: 这正是近年来多次改革立法尝试均告失败的原因，致使邮政服务只能通过推迟关键的现代化改造来支付账单。
sentences.en_text: This is why repeated attempts at reform legislation have failed in recent years, leaving the Postal Service unable to pay its bills except by deferring vital modernization.

sentences.cn_text: 现在传来消息称，所有相关方——民主党人、共和党人、邮政服务、工会以及该系统的最大用户——终于就修复该系统的计划达成了一致。
sentences.en_text: Now comes word that everyone involved — Democrats, Republicans, the Postal Service, the unions and the system’s heaviest users — has finally agreed on a plan to fix the system.

sentences.cn_text: 一项正在众议院推进的立法预计将在五年内为美国邮政服务节省约286亿美元，这些资金可用于购置新车辆及其他维持运营的措施。
sentences.en_text: Legislation is moving through the House that would save USPS an estimated $28.6 billion over five years, which could help pay for new vehicles, among other survival measures.

sentences.cn_text: 大部分资金将来自每封信件永久性增加一美分的费率上涨，以及将邮政退休人员纳入联邦医疗保险。
sentences.en_text: Most of the money would come from a penny-per-letter permanent rate increase and from shifting postal retirees into Medicare.

sentences.cn_text: 后一措施将在很大程度上抵消每年预付退休人员医疗保健费用的财政负担，从而解决美国邮政服务及其工会长期以来的不满。
sentences.en_text: The latter step would largely offset the financial burden of annually pre-funding retiree health care, thus addressing a long-standing complaint by the USPS and its unions.

sentences.cn_text: 如果该法案在众议院获得通过，仍需经参议院审议——届时必然会有人指出，这仅是维持邮政服务运转所需的最低限度措施，而非全面改革。
sentences.en_text: If it clears the House, this measure would still have to get through the Senate — where someone is bound to point out that it amounts to the bare, bare minimum necessary to keep the Postal Service afloat, not comprehensive reform.

sentences.cn_text: 美国邮政服务的集体谈判制度没有任何变化，考虑到人员成本占该机构成本的80%，这是一项重大缺失。
sentences.en_text: There’s no change to collective bargaining at the USPS, a major omission considering that personnel accounts for 80 percent of the agency’s costs.

sentences.cn_text: 同样缺失的是关于取消周六信件投递的任何讨论。
sentences.en_text: Also missing is any discussion of eliminating Saturday letter delivery.

sentences.cn_text: 这一符合常识的改革获得了公众的广泛支持，并可为美国邮政服务每年节省20亿美元。
sentences.en_text: That common-sense change enjoys wide public support and would save the USPS $2 billion per year.

sentences.cn_text: 但邮政特殊利益集团似乎已扼杀了该提议，至少在众议院如此。
sentences.en_text: But postal special-interest groups seem to have killed it, at least in the House.

sentences.cn_text: 围绕该法案形成的共识表明，立法者对美国邮政服务可能出现的政治上令人难堪的短期崩溃感到忧虑。
sentences.en_text: The emerging consensus around the bill is a sign that legislators are getting frightened about a politically embarrassing short-term collapse at the USPS.

sentences.cn_text: 然而，这并不表明他们正在认真推动邮政系统的21世纪转型。
sentences.en_text: It is not, however, a sign that they’re getting serious about transforming the postal system for the 21st century.

sentences.cn_text: 美国邮政服务的财务问题部分是由____造成的。
sentences.en_text: The financial problem with the USPS is caused partly by ____

sentences.cn_text: 其不平衡的预算
sentences.en_text: its unbalanced budget.

sentences.cn_text: 其僵化的管理
sentences.en_text: its rigid management.

sentences.cn_text: 技术升级的成本
sentences.en_text: the cost for technical upgrading.

sentences.cn_text: 银行支持的撤出
sentences.en_text: the withdrawal of bank support.

sentences.cn_text: 根据第二段，美国邮政服务未能实现现代化是由于____。
sentences.en_text: According to Paragraph 2, the USPS fails to modernize itself due to ____

sentences.cn_text: 利益集团的干预
sentences.en_text: the interference from interest groups.

sentences.cn_text: 国会提供的资金不足
sentences.en_text: the inadequate funding from Congress.

sentences.cn_text: 邮政服务需求的萎缩
sentences.en_text: the shrinking demand for postal service.

sentences.cn_text: 邮政工会的无能
sentences.en_text: the incompetence of postal unions.

sentences.cn_text: 美国邮政服务及其工会长期以来的不满可通过____得到解决。
sentences.en_text: The long-standing complaint by the USPS and its unions can be addressed by ____

sentences.cn_text: 解除其退休人员医疗保健的负担
sentences.en_text: removing its burden of retiree health care.

sentences.cn_text: 对新车辆进行更多投资
sentences.en_text: making more investment in new vehicles.

sentences.cn_text: 采用新的费率上涨机制
sentences.en_text: adopting a new rate-increase mechanism.

sentences.cn_text: 吸引更多一类邮件用户
sentences.en_text: attracting more first-class mail users.

sentences.cn_text: 在最后一段中，作者对立法者似乎持有____态度。
sentences.en_text: In the last paragraph, the author seems to view legislators with ____

sentences.cn_text: 尊重
sentences.en_text: respect.

sentences.cn_text: 宽容
sentences.en_text: tolerance.

sentences.cn_text: 不满
sentences.en_text: discontent.

sentences.cn_text: 感激
sentences.en_text: gratitude.

sentences.en_text: Which of the following would be the best title for the text?

sentences.en_text: The USPS Starts to Miss Its Good Old Days

sentences.en_text: The Postal Service: Keep Away from My Cheese

sentences.cn_text: 美国邮政服务：沉疴需用猛药
sentences.en_text: The USPS: Chronic Illness Requires a Quick Cure

sentences.cn_text: 邮政服务需要的不仅是权宜之计
sentences.en_text: The Postal Service Needs More than a Band-Aid
